codeReview.summary: The feature adds both row filtering and monthly pre-extraction parsing with substantial test coverage, but one core requirement is not enforced correctly: CY filtering is applied based only on granularity, not on whether the question is calendar-year scoped.

issues.description: CY row filtering is activated for every `granularity == "monthly_all"` request (`ctx = filter_cy_rows(...)`) without checking if the question/spec is actually calendar-year scoped. The validation contract requires filtering only for CY context (VAL-EXTR-005). Current behavior can over-filter fiscal-monthly requests by suppressing fiscal summary rows even when the question is not CY.

`test_extract_structured_adds_pre_extraction_annotation` is effectively non-assertive: both branches end in `pass`, so the test succeeds whether or not the annotation is present. This weakens regression protection for VAL-EXTR-004 integration behavior.

This feature commit also broadens Bandit skips (`B404`, `B110`, `B112`, `B603`, `B607`) in project-wide config, which is unrelated to monthly pre-extraction/row filtering and reduces security signal scope.

sharedStateObservations.observation: pipeline-worker guidance conflicts with mission guidance on lint/typecheck scope, which can push workers into unnecessary repo-wide diagnostics and workaround behavior.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: .factory/skills/pipeline-worker/SKILL.md Step 4 requires `uv run ruff check .` and `uv run pyright`, while mission AGENTS.md explicitly requires scoped checks on modified files only.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Pre-commit failure handling for unrelated/pre-existing findings is under-specified, and in this run it coincided with unrelated global config edits in a feature commit.
